summary: This is a Docker Compose configuration that defines a single service called app_python. It builds a Docker image from the current directory and mounts the current directory into the container so that code changes on your machine are immediately reflected inside the running container.

explanations.3: The 'build: .' tells Docker Compose to build an image using the Dockerfile in the current directory (the dot means 'here').
explanations.5: This line mounts your local current directory onto a path inside the container called /app/src, so any files you edit locally will be accessible in the same way inside the running container.
